# Born 2026-07-09 from the KB-VIO-110 dropped-execution incident (Gate A/C fired 7/2 into a frozen VIOLET session; tail-hedge packet-build never ran; found 7/9).
# SCOPE: action-gates only. Predictions that merely get GRADED later stay in the owning agent's PREDICTIONS ledger — do not duplicate them here.

# STATES: LIVE · FIRED-UNEXECUTED (🔴 blocking — clear or escalate to Will same session, never leave standing) · RESOLVED <date+verdict> · LAPSED <date+why> · RETIRED. LIVE on a multi-leg / recurring gate whose fired leg's consequence has EXECUTED (route or packet ran, recorded in last_checked) means 'no fired-and-UNEXECUTED leg', never 'nothing has fired' — FALCON-001 legs 1+3, OSPREY-001 leg (b) and CORAL-MSI-01 (its 🔴 = the thesis status ratified 7/23; the ROW is the 8/23 stand-down falsifier) stay LIVE for their remaining legs / clocks by this rule.

# BOOT RULE (wired into PROME/BOOT.md step 3): any FIRED-UNEXECUTED row blocks new work. LIVE-row staleness keys on the consumed_by field (8/7 ruling below; the old >5d raw-age clause that lived on this line was the ruling's un-propagated residue — reconciled 8/9, spine-audit #8).

# STATE CELL CONTRACT (WQ-131, Will-approved 2026-08-29): lead token + ONE-LINE current state + `· hist→GATES_STATE_HISTORY`, whole cell ≤220 chars. Consumers: status logic (prome_gate · will_brief · will_handbook counts) reads the lead token; the dashboard renders up to 220 chars; will_handbook.py:468 searches the current state text when associating a position with a gate — so a LIVE row that watches a position should NAME its ticker in the one-liner. Full prior cell text lives VERBATIM in the PROME/archive/GATES_STATE_HISTORY_*.md family (one file per rotation pass — 2026-08-29 = superseded state cells; 2026-09-03_step2 = rotated Prior-chains from last_checked/consumed_by/review_by), keyed by gate_id with entry-crc32 (recompute, never trust; grep by gate_id, never whole-read). Append history there, never in the cell; the cell is current state only. A row registered AFTER the latest rotation has no entry there until its first cell supersession — the suffix names the destination, not a present entry.

# MAINTENANCE: PROME owns this file. Register a row the same session a gate is approved; resolve/lapse rows the session their verdict lands. Owners' own KBs stay canonical for full logic — this is the coordination-layer index so a fired gate can never again be orphaned by its owner freezing.

# TERMINAL-ROW ARCHIVE (WQ-166, Will 'approed go ahead' 2026-09-03 09:17): rows RESOLVED/LAPSED/RETIRED ≥7 days ago rotate VERBATIM to PROME/archive/GATES_TERMINAL_ROWS_<date>.tsv (entry-crc32 in that file's header; first pass 9/3: 14 rows, all resolved ≤8/28) — the live file carries LIVE + FIRED-UNEXECUTED + terminal rows resolved within ~7 days.
